payload.title: Inventory prior experiments and already-used dataset splits
payload.description:
## Scope

Audit the checked-in AG News, Emotion small/large-context, and Emotion selection protocols and results in Few-Shot-Jev. Record dataset revisions, IDs/splits, task wording, ordering, selection decisions, and prior exposure. Cite historical results directly; do not merge their scores into a new confirmatory result.

## Definition of done

A study inventory names which candidate/development/scoreboard resources can be reused for reproducibility and which are already exposed. If a fresh holdout is unavailable, label the planned analysis as replication/exploratory or choose additional data.

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-731c3e14-b2bb-5b69-bdc4-3ab8bba7cca6`.

These are cross-repository references; local Kanbus blocked-by relationships encode prerequisites within this repository.
